communications_intro: Choose which channels carry each message the shop sends. A yellow i means the message costs more or is promotional, and turning it on asks for your password. A red i means a security risk; those channels stay off.
comm_use_step_up_code: Code before a sensitive account change
comm_use_new_contact_code: Code to a new email or mobile number
comm_use_contact_change_warning: Warning to the old email or mobile number
comm_use_order_on_backorder: Item on backorder, with dispatch date
comm_use_order_refunded_sold_out: Item sold out before payment, order refunded
comm_reason_phone_has_code: Off by choice: customers who use a phone already sign in with a code. Turning this on sends a reset link by text and adds cost.
comm_reason_email_proof: Security risk: this link proves the customer owns the email address. Sent to a phone, it would mark the email as verified without that proof, so someone could claim another person’s email.
comm_reason_staff_email_proof: Security risk: a staff invitation proves the person owns their work email. Sent to a phone, whoever holds that phone could set up an admin account.
comm_reason_payment_link_texts: Off by choice: payment links in text messages are what scammers copy. The customer already sees the failure on the checkout page.
comm_reason_sms_no_file: Off by choice: a text cannot carry the invoice file, so it would send a link instead, at extra cost.
comm_reason_not_urgent_cost: Off by choice: not urgent, and every message costs money.
comm_reason_sms_promotional_route: Operators may treat this as promotional: it then goes only to customers who agreed, between 10:00 and 21:00, at the promotional rate.
comm_reason_whatsapp_marketing_rate: Meta will likely charge this as marketing, about ₹0.86 a message instead of ₹0.115, and only to customers who agreed.
comm_reason_promotional_sms: Promotional: only to customers who agreed to marketing, sent between 10:00 and 21:00, charged per message.
comm_reason_promotional_whatsapp: Marketing on WhatsApp: only to customers who agreed, about ₹0.86 a message.
comm_reason_newsletter_email_only: A newsletter is a full email page. It cannot be sent as a text or WhatsApp message.
comm_confirm_password_only: Only your password confirms this, even if you usually sign in with your PIN.
comm_error_invalid_password: That password is not right. Nothing changed.
comm_error_locked: This channel stays off: it is a security risk.
comm_error_unavailable: This message cannot be sent on that channel.
comm_error_email_required: Codes always go by email as well, so email stays on.
comm_error_phone_channel_required: Keep SMS or WhatsApp on, so customers who use a phone still get their code.
comm_error_not_saved: The change was not saved. Please try again.

lang_admin_text_missing: The admin's own words are not in this release yet.
lang_add_help: Only languages whose menu and button text came with the latest release can be added. It starts as a draft: nothing shows on the shop.
lang_none_to_add: Every language in this release is already added.
lang_area_shop_text: Shop menu and button text (comes with a release)
lang_area_admin_text: Admin menu and button text (comes with a release)

lang_shop_off_body_other: Visitors and Google will be sent from every /{{code}}/… address to the same page in English, for good (301). {{count}} addresses are in the sitemap today.

lang_delete_body_other: It leaves every list and switch in the admin and the shop. Its text stays stored: {{count}} items have {{language}} text. Adding {{language}} again brings it all back.

lang_erase_body_other: {{language}} was deleted on {{date}}. Its text is still stored in {{count}} items.

lang_reminder: {{language}} is deleted, but its text is still stored. Erase it or keep it.
lang_missing_filter: Showing only what is missing in {{language}}.
lang_error_english_fixed: English is always on and can't be changed.
lang_error_not_in_release: This language's menu and button text hasn't come with a release yet.
lang_error_admin_text_incomplete: The admin's menu and button text for this language is not complete yet.

fm_empty_body_one: {{count}} item will be deleted for good. This can’t be undone.
fm_empty_body_other: {{count}} items will be deleted for good. This can’t be undone.

fm_stored_as_is: Stored as it is: no second bar
fm_share_website_picture_help: The address the website already uses. It never expires.
fm_share_original_help: Exactly as uploaded. For a printer, a photographer or a marketplace.
fm_share_private_help: Admins see it in Media; anyone else needs a link you make
fm_share_public_help: A permanent web address, for linking from the website

fm_share_pick_date: Pick the date the link stops working.
fm_share_shown_once: Copy it now: the full link is shown only once. The list below names links by their last characters.

fm_storage_others: Other admins may use on-demand storage

profile_intro: Each profile tells the image worker what to make: shape, sizes, how to fill a different shape, and the upload limits. Pick them when uploading or from Reprocess.
profile_fills: Fills offered when the shape differs
profile_keep_shape_no_fills: This profile keeps each photo's own shape, so there is nothing to fill.
profile_switched_off: {{name}} is off: hidden from upload and pickers
profile_saved: Profile saved. It applies to versions made from now on.
profile_in_use_title_one: This profile is used by {{count}} image
profile_in_use_title_other: This profile is used by {{count}} images
profile_in_use_body_one: Deleting it would leave that image without these sizes. Turn it off instead: it disappears from upload and pickers, and the image keeps working.
profile_in_use_body_other: Deleting it would leave those {{count}} images without these sizes. Turn it off instead: it disappears from upload and pickers, and the {{count}} images keep working.
profile_delete_body: No image uses it. It disappears from upload, pickers and Reprocess.
profile_name_help: Shown in upload, picker and reprocess lists.
profile_name_built_in: A built-in profile keeps its name, so every screen and language names it the same.
profile_size_invalid: A size is a whole number from 16 to 8192 px, listed once, at most 12 per row.
profile_never_enlarged: Never enlarged: sizes bigger than the photo are skipped.
profile_format_jpeg: JPEG (only where a size needs it)
profile_formats_help: The website's pictures are WebP (PNG for icons). Emails and link previews get JPEG by themselves. Leave Quality empty to keep each size's own (80–86).
profile_smallest_help: Below this, the upload shows a yellow note (or is refused). Leave it empty for no limit.
profile_fills_help: When a photo is a different shape, the admin ticks one or more of these for that photo. Each one ticked becomes its own version. Stretching is never offered.
profile_max_upload_help: Cannot be more than the shop-wide limit of 25 MB.
profile_types_help: Every type here is made into versions; HEIC is turned into JPEG in the browser before it uploads. A PSD gives its flattened picture, an ICO its largest picture, and an SVG is drawn 4096 px on its long edge.
profile_status_help: Off: hidden from upload and pickers. Images already made keep working.
profile_changes_apply: Changes apply to versions made from now on. Versions already made never change, so no live picture moves. To remake older ones on purpose, use
profile_refresh_link: Bring older versions up to date
profile_refresh_title: Bring older versions up to date?
profile_refresh_body: Photos: {{photos}} · versions: {{versions}}. Each is made again with today's settings, and the pages switch when it is ready.
profile_refresh_keep: About {{size}} more storage while the old files are kept for 7 days.
profile_refresh_none: Every {{name}} version is up to date
profile_refresh_running: {{name}} is already being brought up to date
profile_refresh_busy: Photos left for now because they were busy: {{count}}. Run it again later for them.
profile_refresh_failed_start: Could not start bringing the versions up to date
profile_refresh_failed: Photos that could not be remade: {{count}}

profile_error_built_in: A built-in profile cannot be deleted. Switch it off instead.
profile_error_built_in_name: A built-in profile keeps its name.
profile_error_in_use: Images use this profile. Switch it off instead.
profile_error_keep_shape_fills: A profile that keeps the photo's own shape has nothing to fill.
profile_error_fill_for_icons_only: Brand colour is for icon profiles only.
profile_error_too_large: The upload limit cannot be more than 25 MB.
profile_error_unknown_family: These sizes belong to a size family the profile does not make.
profile_error_unknown: The profile could not be saved. Try again.
search_hint_setting_image_profiles: Shapes, sizes and fills the image worker makes for each kind of photo.
fm_profiles_suggested: Profiles were suggested from each photo's shape

fm_note_small: Smaller than {{profile}} asks: {{has}} px, it asks for {{px}} px. Bigger sizes are skipped.
fm_note_too_small: Too small for {{profile}}: it needs {{px}} px, this one has {{has}} px.
fm_noted_note_one: {{count}} image has notes. You will be asked to confirm.
fm_noted_note_other: {{count}} images have notes. You will be asked to confirm.

fm_over_others: Other files (PDFs, videos, backups) have no size limit from us.

fm_notes_body_other: {{count}} images don't fit a profile you picked:
fm_key_paste: Paste a picture to upload it here
fm_unreadable_photo: This photo can't be read. Not uploaded.
fm_heic_as_jpeg: HEIC photo: uploads as a full-size JPEG
fm_sharing_pictures_meta: link preview, status card, feed square, email picture · made while this is a product's main photo
fm_versions_help: Every level opens and closes with its arrow; the first version opens first. A long tree scrolls inside this box. Versions already made never change.
fm_activity_help: Kept for as long as the file exists.

fm_rp_keeps_shape: Keeps the photo's own shape: used as is, no fill.
fm_rp_many_shapes: Photos of another shape get each fill you tick; photos that already have this shape are kept as is.
fm_rp_same_shape: Same shape as the photo: used as is, no fill.
fm_rp_tick_for_fills: Different shape. Tick it to choose fills.
fm_rp_other_shape: Different shape: a {{photo}} photo in a {{box}} box. Each fill you tick becomes its own version.
fm_rp_too_small: Too small: this profile needs {{px}} px, the photo has {{has}} px.
fm_rp_too_large: The photo is over this profile's upload limit.
fm_rp_crop_width: Crop keeps only the middle {{pct}}% of the photo's width. Check the preview first.
fm_rp_crop_height: Crop keeps only the middle {{pct}}% of the photo's height. Check the preview first.
fm_rp_smaller: Smaller than this profile asks: {{has}} px, it asks for {{px}} px. Bigger sizes are skipped, never enlarged.
fm_rp_many_help: Each photo gets only the versions it doesn't have yet. Photos that already have a profile's shape are kept as is; any that can't take a version are listed afterwards.
fm_rp_notes_body_one: {{count}} of the new versions has a note:
fm_rp_notes_body_other: {{count}} of the new versions have a note:

fm_rp_skipped_other: {{count}} versions were left out: already made, or the photo can't take them

fm_zip_keep_working: You can keep working. The download starts when it is ready.

gstin_already_saved: This GSTIN is already saved as {{name}}.
gstin_unchecked: The GSTIN couldn't be checked just now; it is checked again when you save.
gstin_fifteen_characters: 15 characters, as printed on their bill.
gstin_required_for_kind: Regular and Composition suppliers need a GSTIN.
supplier_kind_composition_long: Composition (cannot charge GST, no input credit)
supplier_kind_help: It decides the tax on every bill: Regular suppliers charge GST we can claim; Composition and Unregistered suppliers charge none.
supplier_legal_name_help: As printed on their bills. Used on purchase records and the purchase register for the CA.
supplier_legal_name_required: Type the name printed on their bills.
supplier_short_name_help: What staff see in lists. Left empty, lists show the legal name.
supplier_state_from_gstin: Filled from the GSTIN. Changing it is blocked while the GSTIN is set.
supplier_terms_help: Sets the due date on each purchase entry.
their_item_codes_help: Lets a purchase line be found by the supplier's own code (for example BSW-K-118).
supplier_active_help: Inactive suppliers stay in the books but can't be picked for new orders or bills.
supplier_same_pan_title: A supplier with this PAN already exists:
supplier_same_pan_body: {{name}} ({{gstin}}). A second GSTIN under the same PAN is allowed for a branch in another state.
payment_amount_invalid: Type an amount in rupees, like 1,83,750 or 9295.61.
payment_amount_over: More than is left on this bill ({{left}}).
payment_amount_help: Part payments are fine; the entry shows Part paid until the rest is in.
payment_reference_help: UTR, UPI reference or cheque number. No bank account numbers here.
bill_near_itc_limit: A bill is near the 180-day input-credit limit
supplier_statement_empty: No bills, payments or returns yet.
supplier_not_found: This supplier isn't there any more.
supplier_nothing_to_pay: Nothing is left to pay to this supplier.
bill_dated_in_future: The bill is dated in the future. Check the date.
goods_long_before_bill: Goods were received more than 30 days before the bill date. Check both dates.
books_closed_up_to: Books are closed up to {{date}}: nothing can be dated on or before it.
nothing_due_soon: Nothing due in the next 7 days
check_goods_intro: Count what came in the parcel. Anything damaged, wrong or missing is kept out of stock and goes onto a return draft for the supplier.
cost_before_gst_claimable: before GST: the GST is claimable
count_must_add_up: Good, damaged and missing must add up to the bill quantity.
count_note_for_other: Say what is wrong in the note.
count_saved_waiting_to_post: The count is saved. Someone who can post to stock finishes it.
damage_note_placeholder: What is wrong, for example: border torn near the pallu
debit_note_draft_made: a debit-note draft for what is missing
return_draft_made: a return draft for the damaged pieces
draft_product_from_category: HSN {{hsn}} and "can be returned: {{returnable}}" come from the category.
draft_product_from_category_no_hsn: This category has no HSN yet; "can be returned: {{returnable}}" comes from it. Add the HSN on the category or the product.
draft_product_intro: For a new design that has arrived. It goes into the catalogue as a draft with this stock. Photos, descriptions, Bengali text and Go Live happen later in the product form, as for any product.
draft_product_prefix_help: This category has no SKUs yet: type the letters its SKUs start with, for example ST-TNT-.
draft_product_sku_after_category: The SKU is given once a category is picked.
email_addresses_wrong: These don't look like email addresses: {{list}}
import_columns_help: Columns: SKU or their code, quantity, unit price, HSN, GST %.
import_csv_help: Save the sheet as CSV (File › Save as › CSV) and choose it here. Fabric by the metre: quantity in metres.
import_csv_only: Save the spreadsheet as CSV first, then choose that file.
import_columns_missing: The first row needs the headings: SKU or their code, Quantity, Unit price (HSN and GST % are optional).
import_empty: The sheet has no lines to read.
import_pick_exact_sku: Type the exact SKU or name
import_pick_supplier_first: Pick the supplier first: their own item codes are matched to ours.
import_problem_repeated_at_other_price: Same item again at another price
import_problem_blocked_product: Can't take stock (discontinued or a bundle)
line_blocked_bundle: A bundle: stock goes on its contents
line_disabled_product: Disabled: takes stock, not shown on the shop
line_search_nothing: Nothing matches. Check the SKU or the supplier's code.
line_search_placeholder: Add a line: type SKU, name, barcode or their item code — or scan
make_draft_product_link: Not in the catalogue? Make a draft product
mrp_below_selling: MRP can't be below the selling price.
new_variant_not_listed: New colour or size not listed
on_posting_return_draft: A return draft is made for {{what}} damaged.
on_posting_debit_note: A debit-note draft is made for {{what}} missing.
on_posting_bill_counts_in_full: The supplier's bill still counts in full until they send a credit note.
payment_reverse_body: The payment of ₹{{amount}} is undone and the bill shows what is left again. The payment stays in the history.
pe_add_bill_copy: Add the bill's photo or PDF
pe_bill_copy_help: Photo or PDF, kept in Media › Documents › Purchase bills.
pe_fix_lines_first: Fix the lines marked in red first.
pe_freight_help: Shared across lines by value, so it becomes part of each piece's cost.
pe_lines_need_a_look_one: {{count}} warning needs a look before posting.
pe_lines_need_a_look_other: {{count}} warnings need a look before posting.
pe_no_lines_yet: No lines yet. Scan a barcode, search, or
pe_not_found: This purchase entry isn't there any more.
pe_order_help: Pick an open order to fill the lines with what is still to arrive.
pe_order_help_chosen: Lines below came from the order: what is still to arrive.
pe_pick_bill_copy: Choose the bill's photo or PDF
pe_prices_help: Pick "Including GST" for bills that print only the final price.
pe_prices_no_gst_help: This supplier charges no GST: the bill's price is the cost.
pe_printed_help: Typed from the paper. It must match the lines (₹1 round-off allowed).
pe_received_help: Stock and cost start from this date.
pe_received_required: Type the day the goods came.
pe_search_placeholder: Entry no., bill no., supplier or SKU
pe_total_mismatch_less: Lines add up to {{lines}}: {{gap}} less than the bill. Find the missing amount or set the round-off. Check goods stays off until they match.
pe_total_mismatch_more: Lines add up to {{lines}}: {{gap}} more than the bill. Check prices and quantities. Check goods stays off until they match.
pe_total_mismatch_short: The bill total does not match the lines.
pe_type_printed_total: Type the bill total as printed first.
pe_warnings_never_block: You can still post: each warning is written into the entry's activity with who posted it.
po_cancel_body: {{number}} is cancelled: nothing has arrived against it. The supplier is not told; let them know yourself.
po_close_short_body: {{number}} ends with what arrived; {{short}} will not come. Damaged or missing pieces already went to returns and debit notes.
po_close_short_help: For example: the supplier has stopped weaving this design.

po_expected_help: Late orders get a red badge and a bell reminder.
po_line_search_placeholder: Add a line: SKU, name, barcode or their item code
po_moves_nothing: An order moves no stock and owes no money. Stock arrives through the purchase entry made from it when the goods come; the bill sets the final price.
po_no_lines_yet: No lines yet. Search or scan above.
po_not_found: This purchase order isn't there any more.
po_received_note: Received counts the bill quantity of each linked purchase entry. Damaged or missing pieces on the goods check go to the supplier as returns and debit notes, and do not reopen the order.
po_send_from_help: Sent through the mailbox connected in Settings › Mailboxes, so replies land in Inbox.
po_send_marks_sent: Sending marks the order Sent and records who sent it and how.
po_send_no_mailbox: No mailbox you can send from. Connect one in Settings › Mailboxes, or download the PDF.
po_send_to_help: From the supplier record. Add more with commas.
post_locks_entry: After posting the entry is locked. Mistakes are fixed with a purchase return or a stock adjustment, never by editing.
qty_metres_step: Metres go in steps of 0.1 m (2.5, not 2.55).
scan_camera_unavailable: The camera can't read barcodes here: type the SKU instead.
tax_inclusive_everywhere: Tax-inclusive, as everywhere in the shop.
variant_grid_new_tab_note: A new colour opens the product's Variants in a new tab; this list updates when you come back.
variant_grid_price_note: One price fills every row; change a row to differ.
void_body: {{number}} is voided: its stock comes back out and what we owe goes. Allowed only while nothing from it has sold, been reserved or been returned.
void_help: For example: entered against the wrong supplier.
void_refused_body: Pieces from it have already sold, are in a paid checkout, or went back, so taking them out would leave the shop short.
void_refused_help: To send pieces back, make a purchase return. To fix a typo in a cost or quantity, an owner can void and re-enter it only while nothing from it has sold.
warn_price_jump: {{pct}}% dearer than last time ({{price}}). Check the bill.
warn_price_jump_entry: {{pct}}% dearer than last time ({{price}} on {{entry}}). Check the bill.
warn_margin_floor: Margin {{margin}}%: under your {{floor}}% floor. Selling price {{price}}.
warn_hsn_mismatch: Supplier's bill says HSN {{bill}}; this product uses {{product}}. Check which is right.
warn_disabled_product: The product is disabled: it takes stock but the shop doesn't show it.
warn_lookalike_bill: This supplier has another bill with the same total on the same day: {{bill}}. Check it isn't the same bill.
settle_amount_help: Less than the open {{open}}? The gap stays open on their statement.
settle_pick_copy: Choose the credit note or proof
pr_cap_body: {{sku}} has {{onHand}} on hand: {{held}} held and {{inOrders}} in paid orders waiting to ship. {{free}} can go back.
pr_cap_help: Release the held pieces first, or return what is free now and the rest later.
pr_claim_info: A claim for goods that never came: no stock moves. Sending gives the debit note its number.
pr_value_info: Value is what these pieces cost us on that entry, plus GST as the bill charged it. On sending, stock drops and the debit note gets its number.
pr_entry_help: Only posted entries. The cost comes back off that entry's own cost.
pr_more_than_free: More than can go back: see why.
pr_not_found: This return isn't there any more.
pr_nothing_to_return: Nothing from this entry can go back now.
pr_search_placeholder: Debit note no., supplier or SKU
pr_send_claim_body: The claim gets its debit note number. No stock moves. Total:
pr_send_goods_body: The goods leave stock, the debit note gets its number and a delivery challan goes with them. Total:
pr_short_supply_help: Short supplied makes a claim only: no goods are sent back.
label_sheet_help: Many items fill one sheet. A label printer can be added later.
start_at_label_help: Skips labels already used on a part-used sheet.
labels_add_more: Add more items: SKU, name or scan
labels_from_entry: Opened from {{number}} with one label per piece received.
labels_summary_one: {{count}} label on {{sheets}} sheet, starting at label {{start}}.
labels_summary_other: {{count}} labels on {{sheets}} sheets, starting at label {{start}}.
adjust_outcome_writtenOff: Written off: input tax credit reversed
adjust_posting_itc: Written off: its input tax credit, {{amount}}, is reversed by journal voucher {{journal}} (s.17(5)(h)). Lost, stolen, destroyed and free samples do the same.
adjust_posting_journal: Its value goes to the books by journal voucher {{journal}}.
sa_changed_reports_out: Value −{{value}}; shows under Damaged and written off
sa_reverse_note: Reverse (super admin) makes {{next}} ({{change}}) and a reversing JV; this one stays as it is, marked reversed.
sa_reverse_body: Makes {{next}} ({{change}}) and a voucher reversing {{journal}}. This adjustment stays as it is, marked reversed.
sa_problem_adjustment_not_posted: Only a posted adjustment can be reversed.
sa_problem_adjustment_is_a_reversal: A reversal isn’t reversed again; make a new adjustment instead.
sa_problem_stock_moved_meanwhile: The pieces it added have left the stock since. Count them first.
sa_problem_reverse_super_admin_only: Only a super admin can reverse an adjustment.
adjust_now_line: On hand {{onHand}} · held {{held}} · free to sell {{free}}
adjust_note_help: It goes into the audit log word for word.
adjust_note_help_writeoff: Needed for every write-off. It goes into the audit log word for word.
adjust_note_required: Write what happened (every write-off needs a note).
adjust_photos_help: Proof for the CA when input credit is reversed on goods written off.
approvals_note: Requests come from people without Approve write-offs. People who have it write off directly, recorded as approved by themselves. Approvals and rejections, with the reason, go into the audit log and the item's stock history.
cost_layers_note: Only people with See cost and stock value see this tab and the cost columns. Shoppers never see cost. The oldest piece sells first in the books (FIFO), whichever saree leaves the shelf.
held_note: Held pieces stay in on-hand stock and in the stock value, but the shop can't sell them. Releasing needs no approval; writing off follows the approval rule.
history_never_edited: Rows are never edited or deleted. A mistake is put right by a new row that says why.
needs_approval_body: Every write-off is approved by someone with Approve write-offs. Stock stays as it is until then.
reject_help: They see this in their notifications.
request_rejected: Rejected; the requester is told why.
sold_in_last_30_days_one: {{count}} of them sold in the last 30 days
sold_in_last_30_days_other: {{count}} of them sold in the last 30 days
stock_item_not_found: This item isn't there any more.
variants_at_or_under_level: variants at or under their level
you_can_approve_body: so this one applies at once and is recorded as approved by you.
your_own_request: Your own request: someone else approves it.
reorder_intro: Items at or under their low-stock level, or likely to run out within 14 days at the last 60 days' pace. The suggestion covers 45 days. Tick lines, then make draft purchase orders: one per supplier.
nothing_to_reorder: Nothing needs buying again just now.
uncosted_units_note: {{count}} units have no cost yet (stock typed before opening stock): load them through opening stock.
value_on_date_note: Worked out from the movement history and cost layers as they stood at the end of that day, so a closed year's figure never changes.
register_note: Columns follow the CA's capture list (21 Aug 2026). The export layout for GSTR-2B matching waits on the CA (round 2, B8.5).
unpaid_note: Rows turn yellow from {{days}} days after the bill date, before the 180-day input-credit rule (CA to confirm, round 2 B8.2).
count_where_help: Expected figures are that location's stock, and the differences correct that location. Every location counts the whole stock as one.
blind_count_help: Counters don't see what the system expects, so they count what is really there. Recommended.
keep_selling_help: The count remembers stock at the start and adds back what sold while counting, so the shop stays open.
count_sent_to_review: Count finished: it is ready to review.
count_posted: Count posted: differences are now count corrections.
count_post_direct: You have Approve write-offs, so posting applies at once. Each line posts as a count correction with the counter's note.
count_post_request: Posting sends the differences for approval: stock waits until someone with Approve write-offs agrees.
count_waiting_note: Waiting for someone with Approve write-offs.
opening_intro: For stock already in the shop before purchase entries begin (the move off WordPress, or a new branch). Each row needs a cost, so profit and stock value are right from day one. Posting is one-time per SKU; after that, stock only moves through purchase entries, returns, orders and adjustments.
opening_sheet_help: Columns: SKU, Quantity (pieces, or metres in steps of 0.1 m for fabric sold by the metre), Cost each (per piece or per metre, as in your books: before GST if you claimed the GST back), Received on (2026-03-14 or 14/03/2026; empty means today), Note. Save the sheet as CSV first.
opening_fill_cost: Type it in the row, or fix the sheet
opening_post_note: Posting stays off until every row is Ready. Gets number {{number}}. Each SKU can get opening stock once.
opening_columns_missing: The first row needs the headings SKU and Quantity (Cost each, Received on and Note are read when present). Use the template.
opening_date_unreadable: Can't read the received date (sheet rows: {{rows}}). Type it as 2026-03-14 or 14/03/2026, or leave it empty for today.
opening_too_many_rows: One sheet can hold up to 20,000 rows. Split it into two files.
write_offs_rule: Every write-off needs Approve write-offs. People who have it write off directly; everyone else sends a request.
write_offs_rule_help: Give or take the permission in Roles, or on one user (a small role holding only it).
must_be_different_person: Must be a different person from the step before
role_no_longer_exists: A role that no longer exists
purchase_steps_help: Today one person may do every step. Pick a role to keep a step to it, or switch a step on to need a second person. Only the super admin changes this.
purchase_steps_help_locked: Only the super admin changes who may do each step.
margin_floor_help: Lines under it show a red warning; posting is still allowed.
books_closed_help: No purchase entry, return, payment or adjustment can be dated on or before this day (after the GST return is filed). Opening stock is not affected: it enters the books on the day it is posted.
books_closed_help_locked: Set by the super admin. No purchase entry, return, payment or adjustment can be dated on or before this day.
books_closed_future: The books can only be closed up to today.
books_reopen_body: Days after {{to}} and up to {{from}} open again: purchase entries, returns, payments and adjustments can be dated in them. Do this only if the GST return for those days will be revised. The change goes into the audit log.
books_reopen_body_all: Every day up to {{from}} opens again: purchase entries, returns, payments and adjustments can be dated in them. Do this only if those GST returns will be revised. The change goes into the audit log.
unpaid_bill_alert_help: Warns before the 180-day input-credit rule (CA to confirm, round 2 B8.2).
default_payment_terms_help: Used for a new supplier until their own terms are set.
default_deliver_to_help: Filled into Deliver to on a new purchase order; each order can change it.
whole_number_between: Type a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
settings_last_changed: Last changed {{date}}. Every change goes into the audit log.
search_hint_setting_purchases: Who may do each purchase step, books closed, margin and price warnings.
bell_approvals_waiting_one: {{count}} stock request waits for your approval
bell_approvals_waiting_other: {{count}} stock requests wait for your approval
bell_unpaid_bills_one: {{count}} unpaid bill is {{days}}+ days old: pay it before the 180-day limit
bell_unpaid_bills_other: {{count}} unpaid bills are {{days}}+ days old: pay them before the 180-day limit
bell_held_overdue_one: {{count}} held item is past its reminder
bell_held_overdue_other: {{count}} held items are past their reminder
sold_by_help: Piece or metre. Fixed once the product has stock, stock history or orders.
sold_by_locked_help: Fixed: the product has stock, stock history or orders, all counted in this unit.
shortest_cut_help: The least a customer may buy. Steps of 0.1 m.
quick_lengths_help: Up to 4 buttons on the product page; the label shows in every language (type each language's label on the language switch). Leave empty for none.
weight_per_metre_help: Used for the delivery charge: the order weight is length × this.
metre_cut_invalid: Type the shortest cut in metres, in steps of 0.1 m (for example 1.0).
metre_weight_invalid: Type the weight of one metre in whole grams.
metre_width_invalid: Type the width in inches, or leave it empty.
metre_quick_invalid: Each quick length needs metres in steps of 0.1 m.
metre_quick_below_cut: A quick length cannot be shorter than the shortest cut.
metre_quick_label_missing: Each quick length needs an English label.
stock_moves_help: Stock changes only through purchase entries, returns, orders and adjustments, so every piece has a reason and a cost.
stock_moves_help_variants: All variants together. Each variant below has its own figures and buttons. Stock changes only through purchase entries, returns, orders and adjustments.
stock_after_save: Stock arrives through a purchase entry or opening stock once the product is saved.
stock_status_help: Worked out from free to sell; Made to order stays a switch.
low_stock_level_help: Shows the Low stock badge and puts the item on the reorder list.
main_category_help: The first category is the main one: it sets the HSN and whether it can be returned.

hsn_popup_body_new: The main category is now {{category}}, so the HSN field now shows {{code}}, taken from {{category}}.
hsn_popup_returnable: "Can be returned" also comes from {{category}}: {{now}} (it was {{before}}). A wrong HSN puts the wrong code and tax on invoices. Nothing is saved until you press Save on the form.
hsn_manual_help: 4, 6 or 8 digits. Enter saves it into the HSN field; Esc cancels.
category_hsn_help: Products in this category take this HSN; a product may override it. Codes wait on the CA (round 2, B2.4).
category_returnable_help: Default for products here; a product may override it. Not returnable: made-to-measure, altered, innerwear and petticoats.
category_hsn_note: Changing the HSN here asks whether the products that use the category's HSN take the new one. Products with their own HSN are listed and left alone.
category_hsn_body: {{count}} products use this category's HSN ({{from}}). Give them {{to}} as well?
category_hsn_body_own: {{count}} products use this category's HSN ({{from}}). Give them {{to}} as well? These {{own}} have their own HSN and stay as they are:
pb_pages_note_title: Each page has its own layouts, schedule and search settings.

pb_showing_fixed: The fixed page (no layout live yet)
pb_now_about: Theme demo text, hidden from search
pb_now_category: Fixed: filters, product grid, category FAQ

pb_one_layout: Another can be scheduled to take over and hand back. Your own layouts can be arranged freely.
pb_settings_help: These stay the same whichever layout is showing.

pb_start_copy_help: Custom, with its sections and pictures
search_hint_page_builder: Arrange the shop’s pages from layouts: what shows on Home, and when.

pb_template_today_help: The home page as it is today, with today's pictures
pb_template_full_width_slides_help: A full-width slider, two promo banners, product rows
pb_template_main_side_tile_help: A main picture with one tall picture beside it
pb_template_main_two_stacked_help: A main picture with two pictures stacked beside it
pb_template_centre_side_tiles_help: The three-piece banner: a main picture and two tall pictures
pb_settings_title_help: The title in search results and the browser tab. About 60 characters show in full; this has {{count}}.
pb_settings_description_help: The words under the title in search results. About 160 characters show in full; this has {{count}}.
pb_settings_heading_help: The page's one main heading, for search engines and screen readers. Layouts never change it.
pb_settings_heading_shown_help: Off: read by search engines and screen readers only, as today. On: shown above the sections.
pb_settings_share_help: The picture a link to this page shows on WhatsApp, Facebook and the like. Empty: the site's default.
pb_settings_preview: How a search result would read
pb_settings_preview_cut: Search results cut the words marked "…". The full text stays on the page.
pb_settings_refused: Not saved. Every language the shop shows needs its search title, search description and main heading:
pb_settings_saved: Page settings are saved. Visitors see them on their next page load.
pb_settings_done: Search title, description and main heading in every language
pb_add_linked_help: Off: a copy you can change here. On: linked, so a change to the block reaches every layout using it at its next Go Live.
pb_block_saved: Saved as a block. Add it from Add section in any layout.
pb_block_linked: Linked block: a change to the block reaches this section at its next Go Live
pb_block_copy: A copy of a saved block
pb_choose_section: Choose a section in the outline to change it.
pb_conflict: {{name}} saved this layout after you opened it. Your changes are kept in this tab; open the newer one to carry on.
pb_decorative: Decorative (a pattern or divider: screen readers skip it)
pb_india_time: Times are India time. Empty: always.
pb_link_refused: A link is a shop address starting with / or an https address.
pb_locked_by: {{name}} is editing this layout. You can look and preview; editing waits until they close it.
pb_not_saved_retrying: Not saved, retrying. Your changes are kept in this tab until they save.
pb_outline_empty: No sections yet. Add one to start.
pb_outline_help: Drag a row, or press Space on it, move it with ↑ ↓ and press Space again. Esc puts it back.
pb_phone_sides: On a phone held upright, the side pictures
pb_phone_sides_below_side_by_side: Below the main picture, side by side
pb_phone_sides_main_only: Not shown: the main picture only
pb_section_removed: Section deleted. Tap here or press ⌘/Ctrl + Z to undo.
pb_value_refused: That value is not allowed here.
pb_kb_lifted: {{name}} picked up, place {{position}} of {{count}}. Use the up and down arrows, then Space to drop.
pb_section_banner_arrangement_hint: Pictures in one of the four arrangements; several pictures in a place make a slider.
pb_section_promo_banners_hint: Two wide pictures side by side, each with its own link.
pb_section_product_row_hint: 4 to 12 product cards: new arrivals, bestsellers, a category and more.
pb_section_recently_viewed_hint: The shopper's own recently viewed products, filled in their browser; below the first screen.
pb_section_youtube_videos_hint: The channel's latest videos; each plays on a tap.
pb_section_blog_posts_hint: The newest live posts, or the ones you choose.
pb_section_newsletter_hint: A sign-up for news by email.
pb_save_refused: Not saved: a value is not allowed
pb_preview_failed: The preview could not open. Save, then try again.

pb_changes_first: the shop's fixed home page makes way for this layout, every section new.
pb_changes_none: nothing; the shop already shows this.
pb_pictures_making: Every picture is there; {{count}} still being made
pb_problem_picture_not_ready: the picture is gone or its version is not ready
pb_problem_shape: a different shape from the first picture
pb_phone_done: Every wide picture with words in it has a phone picture
pb_phone_todo: Wide pictures with words in them need a phone picture
pb_summary: {{sections}} sections · sliders: {{sliders}}, holding {{sliderPictures}} pictures · pictures that load first: {{earlyPictures}} (the rest wait)

pb_note_dark_in_a_row: Two dark sections in a row read as one block.
pb_linked_reaches: Linked block “{{name}}”: its latest content goes live here (also linked in: {{layouts}})
pb_budget_early_pictures: Pictures that load with the page
pb_budget_early_pictures_help: One per screen size, asked for first
pb_budget_first_load_code_help: The slider's script, only when the first section has a slider
pb_budget_html_help: Each section at its allowance, with the header and footer
pb_budget_later_code_help: Loads as each section comes near the screen
pb_budget_over: {{measure}}: {{value}}, over the limit of {{limit}}. Remove or simplify a section.
pb_headings_ok: One main heading from Page settings, then section titles and cards in order
pb_links_ok: Every link opens a page that is on the shop
pb_links_todo_one: 1 link opens a page that is not on the shop
pb_links_todo_other: {{count}} links open pages that are not on the shop
pb_slider_ok: Sliders: the pause button first, still for shoppers who ask for less motion
pb_reading_order_ok: Reading order follows the outline on every screen size
pb_ends_needs_other: An end time needs another layout that has been live, to hand back to.
pb_schedule_note_from: On {{when}} IST the shop switches to {{name}} by itself.
pb_schedule_note_until: On {{when}} IST it goes back to {{name}}.
pb_schedule_note_end: Shoppers see the change on their next page load; nothing moves under them.
pb_review_help: The owner or a super admin makes it live. Ask them to review this draft; they see it in the bell.
pb_waits_saved_one: 1 to fix. The draft is saved.
pb_waits_saved_other: {{count}} to fix. The draft is saved.
pb_waiting_text: The layout can go live by itself the moment they are ready, or you can wait. It never goes live with a picture missing.
pb_waiting_go: Go Live when it is ready
pb_history_session: This session (Undo goes back through these)
pb_history_session_empty: No changes yet in this session.
pb_history_note: Every Go Live keeps a copy here too, so a live layout can be put back in one click.
pb_brought_back: That version is the draft again. Undo puts back what was here.
pb_save_first: The draft is not saved yet. Try again in a moment.
pb_went_live: It is live. Shoppers see it on their next page load.

pb_cancel_waiting: Take off this waiting Go Live
pb_safe_mode_start: Safe mode: show the fixed page

pb_done_put_back: Put back. Shoppers see it on their next page load.
pb_done_safe_on: Safe mode is on: the shop shows its fixed page.

perm_page_builder_go_live: Go Live and schedule on every page
lang_area_page_builder: Page Builder (page settings, and words in live and scheduled layouts)

pb_words_ok: Words over pictures read at AA on every screen size, in every language
pb_words_measuring: Words over pictures: the pictures are being measured
pb_words_todo_one: 1 line of words over a picture is hard to read
pb_words_todo_other: {{count}} lines of words over pictures are hard to read
pb_words_no_fix: No colour reads here: move the words to another spot, or put them in the picture.

pb_words_map_measuring: This picture is being measured. The map shows in a moment.

perm_page_builder_go_live_home: Go Live and schedule on the Home page only
shop_details_intro: How the shop names itself on business documents: purchase orders now, debit notes, delivery challans and tax invoices later. Only people with Edit shop details can change it.
shop_details_read_only: Only people with Edit shop details can change these. Ask the owner if something is wrong.
shop_details_missing: Not filled in yet: {{fields}}. Until then purchase orders print the Brand Kit's shop name with no GSTIN, and purchase tax is worked out for West Bengal.
shop_legal_name_help: As on the GST registration certificate. Printed on every document.
shop_trade_name_help: Printed under the legal name only when it is different.
shop_address_help: The principal place of business on the registration.
shop_state_help: Read from the GSTIN. It decides CGST + SGST or IGST on every purchase.
shop_email_help: Suppliers reply here when they cannot use the order email.
shop_logo_help: The Brand Kit's full logo. Change it there.
shop_gstin_ok: Format and check digit are right. State {{code}} is {{state}}: suppliers in {{state}} charge CGST + SGST, suppliers elsewhere IGST.
shop_gstin_check_digit_wrong: The check digit is wrong: the last character should be {{expected}}. Check the GSTIN on the registration certificate.
shop_gstin_state_unknown: The first two digits aren't a State code. Check the GSTIN on the registration certificate.
shop_field_required: Fill this in: it is printed on every document.
shop_pin_shape: A PIN code has 6 digits and does not start with 0.
shop_phone_shape: Use digits, spaces, brackets, - and + only, with 8 to 15 digits.
shop_details_history: Changes apply to documents made from now on; documents already sent keep the details they were printed with.
shop_details_audit_note: Every change goes into the audit log with the old and new values.
shop_change_body: Check the new details before saving.
shop_change_tax_same: Tax on purchases: unchanged, CGST + SGST from {{state}} suppliers and IGST from others
shop_change_no_supplier_moves: Tax on purchases: no supplier changes between CGST + SGST and IGST
shop_change_docs: Documents already sent: keep the old details
shop_change_note: A new GSTIN normally means a new registration. If the State changes too, every draft purchase entry and order works out its tax again on its next save; posted entries never change.
shop_change_note_name: New documents print the new name; documents already sent keep the old one.
one_permission_title: Giving one permission to one person.
one_permission_body: Make a small role that holds only that permission (for example Write-off approver, holding Approve write-offs) and add it to the user. They keep their own role; taking the small role away takes the permission away. The same works for Edit shop details.
search_hint_setting_shop_details: The shop's legal name, GSTIN and address printed on purchase orders and other documents.
returnable_follows_none: No category chosen yet: can be returned.
returnable_set_cat_yes: Set for this product ({{category}}: can be returned).
returnable_set_cat_no: Set for this product ({{category}}: cannot be returned).
ship_zone_unset_help: Checkout can’t show a shipping charge for this zone until one is chosen.
ship_zone_not_needed_help: The shop delivers only inside the home country.
ship_home_country_help: Decides what counts as domestic. The delivery address decides the zone; the currency never does.
ship_mixed_rule_sets: When a cart mixes rule sets
ship_mixed_sum: Add up each rule set’s charge
ship_mixed_rule_sets_help: Happens only when a category or product has its own rule set.
ship_check_every_product: Every live product resolves to a domestic and an international charge.
ship_check_no_box: {{count}} products have no weight or box size. Weight bands and courier quotes can’t price them; the rule sets in use don’t need them.
ship_check_no_box_needed: {{count}} products have no weight or box size, and a rule set in use or a courier needs them. Add a weight or a box on the product or its category.
ship_check_no_own_rules: No category or product has its own rules.
ship_try_any_cart_help: Builds a cart from real products and shows the charge each zone would give, with every step explained.
ship_default_charges_help: Used when neither the product nor any of its categories sets a charge.
ship_check_all_good: Both zones have an active rule set.
ship_check_zone_not_set: {{zone}}: no rule set chosen, so checkout can’t show a shipping charge.
ship_check_rule_set_missing: {{zone}}: the chosen rule set no longer exists.
ship_check_default_charges_zero: The shop-wide default charges are all ₹0; products with no charge on themselves or their categories would ship free.
ship_check_exception_rule_set_missing: An exception uses a rule set that is missing or still a draft.
ship_orders_abroad_intro: How an order delivered outside {{country}} is invoiced and handled. Each choice is a named path; a business picks one.
ship_abroad_askForHomeAddress: Ask for an Indian invoice address
ship_abroad_askForHomeAddress_help: At checkout, when the billing and delivery addresses are both outside India. Every field optional.
ship_abroad_holdPackingUntilComplete: Hold packing until it is complete
ship_abroad_holdPackingUntilComplete_hel: The order can’t be marked Packed until the invoice address has a name, street, city, state and 6-digit PIN code.
ship_abroad_keepBilling: Keep the billing address as entered
ship_abroad_keepBilling_help: Always on: the order keeps every address the shopper typed, for reference.
ship_abroad_exportOffIndianInvoice: Export off — invoice to an Indian address
ship_abroad_exportOffIndianInvoice_help: The GST invoice always carries an address in India: the billing address if it is in India, else the delivery address if it is in India, else an address in India the shopper gives at checkout or staff add later. Parcels abroad are sent by staff outside the system.
ship_abroad_standardExport: Standard export — zero-rated under LUT, or with IGST
ship_abroad_standardExport_help: Designed, not built. Its CA questions are parked for later. It can be chosen only after that path is built.
ship_abroad_indiaOnly_help: Checkout refuses delivery addresses outside the home country. Prices can still show in other currencies.
ship_case_invoice_delivery: Delivery address (kept as the invoice address)
ship_case_invoice_given: The address in India from the optional step; if missing, staff add it
ship_case_sees_form: The optional “Address in India” step; never the staff flag
ship_courier_later: Couriers are connected in a later build
ship_courier_zones_both: Domestic and international quotes, labels, tracking
ship_couriers_note: Each courier is an adapter behind the shipping port: connecting one adds “Courier quote” as a choice for either zone. Domestic and international choose independently; any mix of rule sets and couriers is allowed. Quotes use the product’s weight and box, the delivery PIN code or country, and the pickup address from Shop details.
ship_if_quote_fails_help: Only for “Courier quote”: a time-out or error never leaves a cart without a charge.
ship_on_top_percent: Percentage on top of a quote
ship_no_exceptions: No exceptions: every product follows the site-wide rule sets.
ship_wins_2: Its main category’s exception (the same rule as HSN: the main category wins when a product sits in several).
ship_wins_3: A parent category’s exception that includes its sub-categories, nearest first.
ship_wins_4: Site-wide. A product’s Free shipping switch beats all of these.
ship_search_product: Search a product by name or SKU
ship_cant_ship_warning: “Can’t ship to this zone” hides Buy for shoppers delivering there and stops checkout for that line with a message.
ship_exception_delete_body: The site-wide rule sets apply to these products again.
ship_delete_rule_set_body: “{{name}}” and its versions are deleted. Orders already placed keep the charge they were shown.
ship_used_for_help: Domestic means delivery inside the shop’s home country ({{country}}). The delivery address decides, never the currency.
ship_premade_badge: Pre-made · copied, then yours to change
ship_premade_add-per-unit_help: Each unit costs its product’s shipping charge; lines are added up.
ship_premade_highest-only_help: Only the dearest line’s charge is taken, once.
ship_premade_first-and-further_help: A first-unit charge, then a lower charge for each further unit.
ship_premade_free-above_help: A flat charge, free when the cart reaches a value.
ship_premade_weight-bands_help: Charge by chargeable weight (actual or volumetric, whichever is more).
ship_premade_flat-per-order_help: One charge per order, whatever is in it.
ship_premade_courier-quote_help: Ask the connected courier for a live price, with a fallback rule set.
ship_versions_help: A version never changes once active. Orders record the version that priced them.
ship_amounts_in_rupees: ₹ Rupees. Converted at checkout for shoppers paying in another currency.
ship_status_unsaved: the blocks below are not active yet
ship_status_draft: Draft. Not used at checkout yet.
ship_premade_locked: Pre-made rule sets can’t be changed, so every business starts from the same tested version. Make a copy to edit it.
ship_carts_changed_title: This change alters {{count}} saved test cart(s).
ship_carts_changed_body: Check the new amounts before making it active. Saving still works; the old version stays active until you choose “Save and make active”.
ship_no_carts_to_check: No saved test carts to check.
ship_carts_accepted: {{count}} saved test cart(s) change; their new amounts are accepted.
ship_make_active_body: Carts open now are priced again at checkout. Orders already placed keep the charge they were shown, and each order records which version priced it.
ship_phone_read_only: On a phone, rule sets open to read and try. Building needs a tablet or computer screen.
ship_issues_title: {{count}} thing(s) to fix before this can be made active:
ship_add_adjust: Add minimum, maximum, rounding or “free above”
ship_draft_saved: Draft saved. The active version keeps pricing checkout.
ship_no_test_carts: No test carts yet. Build one in Try it and save it.
ship_test_cart_added: Test cart added; save the rule set to keep it
ship_plain_words_help: Written by the system from the blocks, so staff can check a rule set without reading the builder.
ship_changes_body: With these blocks, these saved carts would cost something else. Accept the new amounts to make this version active.
ship_changes_blocked: A cart that would no longer get a charge can’t be accepted. Change the blocks or remove that test cart.
ship_shown_as: Shown to this shopper as {{amount}} at checkout.
ship_try_pending: Add a charge to see the result.
ship_tester_empty: Add products to see what checkout would charge.
ship_try_blocked: Can’t work out a charge until the mistakes are fixed.
ship_try_unpriced: This cart can’t be priced yet: a zone has no rule set, or its rule set isn’t active.
ship_try_add_product: Add a product by name or SKU
ship_try_empty: Add products to see what this rule set charges.
ship_try_no_result: Some lines get no result. Fill the marked blocks.
ship_try_needs_quote: A courier quote is needed; none is connected.
ship_explain_highest_one: Highest line {{kept}} is taken once; {{dropped}} is dropped.
ship_explain_highest_many: Highest line {{kept}} is taken once; {{dropped}} are dropped.
ship_explain_lowest_one: Lowest line {{kept}} is taken once; {{dropped}} is dropped.
ship_explain_lowest_many: Lowest line {{kept}} is taken once; {{dropped}} are dropped.
ship_explain_adjust_freeAbove: The cart is above the free-shipping value, so {{from}} becomes free.
ship_add_any_group: A group where any one is enough (OR)
ship_add_all_group: A group where all must hold (AND)
ship_slot_empty_error: Lines that reach here get no result
ship_block_if_help: Conditions joined with and / or, groups inside groups
ship_block_bands_help: Several bands, for example weight or subtotal bands
ship_block_amount_help: Fixed ₹: once, per unit, or per kg
ship_block_productCharge_help: From the product, else its category, else the shop default
ship_block_firstAndFurther_help: Two amounts, counted per product or across the cart
ship_block_percent_help: Of the line’s value or the cart’s value
ship_block_cantShip_help: Stops checkout for this line with a message
ship_block_courierQuote_help: Live price from the connected courier
ship_scope_weight_help: Chargeable weight = actual or volumetric (L × W × H ÷ 5,000), whichever is more
ship_band_to_help: A band runs from its From value up to, not including, its To value; an empty To has no limit.
ship_per_kg: for each kg or part of one
ship_count_acrossCart: every unit in the cart, across all products
ship_count_perProduct: each product starts again at its first unit
ship_scope_eachLine_help: Every product line is worked out on its own
ship_scope_eachUnit_help: Every unit is worked out on its own
ship_f_line_discounted_help: Selling price below MRP, set on the product or by an active sale event. Coupons never count.
ship_f_line_quantity_help: Units on the line. A length of fabric counts as one unit.
ship_f_line_sellingPrice_help: Per unit, ₹, after any sale event
ship_f_line_onSaleEvent_help: Yes or no, and which event
ship_f_line_chargeableWeight_help: Actual or volumetric, whichever is more, grams
ship_f_line_charge_domestic_help: From the product, else its category
ship_f_line_charge_internationalFirst_he: From the product, else its category
ship_f_line_charge_internationalFurther_: From the product, else its category
ship_f_cart_chargeableWeight_help: Grams: actual or volumetric, whichever is more
ship_f_delivery_pincode_help: Exact, a range or a list
ship_pw_scope_eachLine: For each line in the cart:
ship_pw_scope_eachUnit: For each unit in the cart:
ship_pw_count_acrossCart: Count every unit in the cart, across all products.
ship_pw_count_perProduct: Count each product’s units on their own.
ship_pw_aside_every: ({{amount}}, set on every category; a product may set its own)
ship_pw_aside_range: ({{amount}} by category; a product may set its own)
ship_pw_combine_highest_eachLine: Keep only the highest line, once.
ship_pw_combine_lowest_eachLine: Keep only the lowest line, once.
ship_pw_combine_highest_eachUnit: Keep only the highest unit, once.
ship_pw_combine_lowest_eachUnit: Keep only the lowest unit, once.
ship_pw_c_line_discounted_no: the piece is at full price
ship_pw_c_line_onSaleEvent_yes: the piece is on a sale event
ship_pw_c_line_onSaleEvent_no: the piece is not on a sale event
ship_pw_c_line_madeToOrder_yes: the piece is made to order
ship_pw_c_line_madeToOrder_no: the piece is not made to order
ship_pw_c_shopper_signedIn_no: the shopper is not signed in
ship_pw_c_shopper_firstOrder_yes: it is the shopper’s first order
ship_pw_c_shopper_firstOrder_no: it is not the shopper’s first order
ship_pw_adjust_freeAbove: Free when the cart is {{amount}} or more.
ship_pw_amount_kg: {{amount}} for each kg or part of one
ship_pw_product_unit: charge the product’s {{charge}} for each unit
ship_pw_product_once_highest: charge the highest product {{charge}} in the cart, once
ship_pw_first_further_perProduct: charge {{first}} for each product’s first unit{{firstAmount}}, then {{further}} for each further unit{{furtherAmount}}
ship_pw_courier: ask the courier for a quote

ship_issue_branch_no_result: some lines get no result. Add what to charge, or “Otherwise”, so every cart gets a shipping charge.
ship_issue_condition_value: the value for “{{field}}” is missing or not the right kind.
ship_issue_condition_impossible: the condition on “{{field}}” can never be true.

ship_issue_amount_missing: an amount is empty. Enter ₹0 or more.

ship_issue_bands_gap: bands leave a gap from {{from}} to {{to}}.

ship_issue_duplicate_block_id: two blocks share one id; duplicate the step again.
ship_issue_charge_zone_mismatch: this uses a charge meant for the other zone.
ship_issue_courier_needed: a courier quote works only once a courier is connected.

ship_category_charge_help: Read by rule sets that use “the product’s domestic charge”. Sub-categories and products inherit it unless they set their own.
ship_used_by_rest: {{inherit}} inherit these values, {{own}} set their own.
ship_default_weight_help: For weight bands and courier quotes. Products may set their own.
ship_use_shop_value: Use the category’s or the shop’s value
ship_weight_also_inventory: Also on the Inventory tab. A variant may set its own.
ship_product_rules_text: Same as its main category unless an exception is set on
ship_free_shipping_help: When on, this product ships free in both zones, whatever the rule sets say.
ship_draft_saved_inactive: Draft saved. It isn’t used at checkout until it is made active.
fx_err_time: Type the time as 24-hour hours and minutes, like 12:30.

pick_this_page: Tick every row on this page
bulk_body_go_live: Each one gets the same check as Go Live on the product form. If a field in any language is empty, that product stays as it is.
bulk_body_take_off: They stay saved with everything in them. Shoppers can't find them, and their pages show "not found" until you put them live again.
bulk_body_discontinue: They leave the shop now. After 30 days their photos and details are removed for good; only the name, SKU and past orders remain. This cannot be undone.

bulk_body_delete: Only products that have never been live, stocked or ordered can be deleted for good. Products that have been live would break orders and links: discontinue them instead.
bulk_reason_replacement_in_batch: The page to send to is among them: {{count}}
bulk_why_was_live: Has been live: discontinue it instead
bulk_why_has_stock: Has stock or stock history: discontinue it instead
bulk_why_has_orders: Is on an order: discontinue it instead
bulk_why_in_event: A launch or sale still names it
bulk_why_replacement_in_batch: The page to send to is being discontinued too
bulk_why_failed: Could not be done; try again
bulk_links_page_help: A live product or collection, for example Sarees › Semi Crepe
bulk_failed: That didn't go through. Nothing changed; please try again.
bulk_report_refused: Could not be done, still selected: {{count}}. Point at an amber chip to see why.

sale_running_help: This sale is running: prices change on the shop straight away.
sale_fixed_help: Type each product's sale price below.
sale_left_out_overlap: In another sale at the same time
sale_left_out_bad_rule: The rule can't apply to its price
sale_once_live: Off shop: on sale once live
sale_own_rule_wins: Already in this sale through its category: its own rule takes over
sale_draft_made: Draft sale made. Give it its name, dates and message, then press Publish.
draft_shop_unchanged: The shop shows the product as it was until you press Update Product.
draft_you_have: You have a draft of changes to this product from {{when}} (fields changed: {{count}}).
draft_someone_has: Another admin has a draft of changes to this product from {{when}}.
draft_nothing_changed: Nothing has changed yet, so there is no draft to save.
draft_saved: Draft saved. Find it in Products › Drafts.
draft_not_saved: That didn't go through. Please try again.
draft_not_found: That draft is no longer there.
draft_discard_body: The draft is thrown away. The product stays exactly as it is.
draft_leave_title: Keep your work on this product?
draft_leave_body: You have changes that aren't saved anywhere yet.

draft_conflict_body: Someone saved this product after your draft began. Choose which value to keep where you both changed the same field. Your other changes go in as they are, and every check still runs.
search_hint_product_drafts: Unfinished products and changes saved as drafts, to pick up again.

ord_shipping_pending: Worked out when the order is closed, for one parcel.

ord_send_needs_msg91: Available once MSG91 is set up

ord_ewaybill_missing: E-way bill not added yet. Shipped stays off until it is in.

ord_rate_note: {{inr}} at {{rate}} per {{code}} with the {{markup}}% PayPal markup.
ord_rates_kept_help: Kept on the order for the records. Prices are never adjusted from these figures.
ord_comment_help: Staff only. Kept in the order’s history with your name.
ord_mark_received_body: The bank transfer of {{amount}} is in our account. Type the UTR from the bank statement.
ord_request_not_paid: Not paid yet. The gateway tells us by itself when it is.
ord_copy_failed: The link could not be copied
ord_action_failed: That didn’t work. Please try again.
ord_status_now: Now: {{status}}. Only the next steps this order can take are listed; the others say why not.
ord_block_madeToOrderPastProcessing: Made-to-order pieces can’t be cancelled after Processing
ord_block_readyPastPacked: Packed: the return policy applies instead
ord_block_onlyFromCourier: Only a connected courier sets this
ord_block_eDocumentsMissing: Add the e-invoice and e-way bill first
ord_ship_manual_help: For parcels booked outside this system
ord_proof_placeholder: Who received it, or the courier’s POD number
ord_cancel_help: The pieces go back on sale. A payment already taken is refunded through the way it came in.
ord_customer_told_nothing: The customer is told nothing for this step; their account shows it.
ord_amount_due_help: Filled with the amount due now ({{amount}}); change it to what actually came in.
ord_manual_rupees_only: Payments by hand are always in ₹. Each one is its own record with its own reference.
ord_edoc_not_connected: No connection for this GSTIN, so this is done on the government portal. The result goes in here and the order changes exactly as it would with a connection.
ord_review_paid-callback-without-record: A paid return with no record at the gateway yet; it is checked again by itself
ord_review_paid-callback-contradicted: The return said paid, the gateway says not
ord_review_paidTwice: Paid twice: one payment is more than due
ord_review_refundNotConfirmed: A refund the gateway hasn’t confirmed

ord_request_at_most: At most the amount due now: {{amount}}.
ord_request_foreign_amount: {{amount}} at {{rate}} per {{code}}, with the {{markup}}% PayPal markup.
ord_request_india_foreign: This customer is billed in India. PayPal India only takes payers outside India, so a request in another currency would fail.
ord_request_problem_method_off: Payment links are switched off in the order settings.
ord_request_problem_nothing_due: Nothing is due on this order.
ord_request_problem_more_than_due: A request can’t be for more than is due now.
ord_request_problem_gateway_not_configur: That gateway isn’t set up on this server yet. Choose another currency.
ord_request_problem_no_contact: The billing contact has no email address or mobile number to send the request to.
ord_request_what_inr: The INR gateway emails and texts {{name}} its own payment request, in its own format. We pass the name, email, mobile, amount, order number and how long it is valid.
ord_request_what_paypal: PayPal emails {{name}} its own payment request. PayPal sends no SMS, and its email wording can’t be changed.
ord_request_our_link_note: Forwards to this request, for chats and for our own Send as SMS / Send as email.
ord_request_after_payment_note: The gateway’s reference is filled in by itself, and the balance drops by the amount paid.
ord_invoice_address_popup_help: Used only on the GST invoice. The parcel still goes to the delivery address.
ord_pin_unknown: India Post doesn’t list this PIN code.
ord_save_invoice_address: Save and use for the invoice
ord_remove_line_body: The order’s goods drop by {{drop}} to {{goods}}, and the {{count}} pieces go back on sale straight away.
ord_remove_line_paid: Already paid: {{paid}}, so {{due}} would still be due.
ord_remove_line_placeholder: For example: they want a different colour
ord_line_removed: Pieces removed and back on sale
ord_close_intro: Closing stops adding pieces. The shipping is worked out now, for one parcel, and the order moves on to Processing.
ord_close_problem_no_addresses: This order has no delivery address.
ord_close_problem_cannot_ship: The shipping for one parcel can’t be worked out for this delivery address. Check the shipping rules.
ord_close_request_now_help: The gateway sends its own request; the order waits for it before packing.
ord_close_record_later: Close now; the shipping is paid by hand later
ord_close_record_later_help: The order shows {{amount}} due until it is recorded.
ord_close_to_account_help: Due by its credit days; the order is placed now.
ord_close_account_note: A business on account can close with the amount due going to its account.
ord_close_nothing_due: The payments already cover this order; it is placed when it is closed.
ord_credit_refusal_creditOnHold: Credit is on hold for this business.
ord_credit_refusal_overLimit: This would go over the business’s credit limit.
ord_credit_refusal_accountsOff: Business accounts are switched off in the order settings.
ord_zone_no_price: Price not set for this zone
ord_no_variants: None of this product’s variants can be sold right now.
ord_no_buyer_found: No one found. Type a name, phone number or email.
ord_currency_note: Prices in this currency use {{rate}} per {{symbol}} plus the PayPal markup. Switch the currency any time; the cart is priced again. A payment taken by hand (UPI, bank transfer, cash) is always in ₹, at ₹ prices.
ord_cart_empty: The cart is empty. Add pieces from the cards.
ord_cart_problem_out_of_stock: Out of stock: remove it or lower the quantity.
ord_cart_problem_limited: Fewer in stock than asked for.
ord_cart_problem_unavailable: No longer on sale: remove it.
ord_cart_problem_noZonePrice: Price not set for this zone: remove it.
ord_shipping_at_checkout: At checkout, from the delivery address
ord_choose_buyer_first: Choose who the order is for before checkout.
ord_new_address_for_order: A new address for this order
ord_name_this_address_hint: For example Home, Office, Mum’s place.
ord_business_invoice_note: The GST invoice carries the business’s legal name and GSTIN.
ord_indian_invoice_help: Shown because both addresses are outside India (Orders sent abroad: export off). Leave it empty if you don’t have it yet: the order will say “Invoice address needed” and can’t be packed until it is added.
ord_cannot_ship_line: {{title}} can’t be sent to this address: remove it from the cart.
ord_quote_failed: The order couldn’t be priced. Check the address and the cart.
ord_choose_delivery_first: Choose or add the delivery address to see the shipping and the total.
ord_pay_paymentLink_help: The customer pays online; the gateway fills the reference
ord_pay_upi_help: Paid to our UPI ID; type the UPI reference
ord_pay_bankTransfer_help: NEFT, RTGS or IMPS; type the UTR
ord_pay_cashOnDelivery_help: Collected when the parcel is handed over
ord_pay_keepOpen_help: Pieces stay held; add more and take payments any time; shipping is worked out when you close it.
ord_keep_open_held: The pieces are held from now until they are removed or the order is cancelled.
ord_keep_open_add: Add pieces from Create order; record payments or request one online at any time.
ord_keep_open_close: Close the order to work out one parcel’s shipping and take what is due.
ord_method_off_noPermission: Needs the permission to keep orders open
ord_method_off_switchedOff: Switched off in the order settings
ord_method_off_foreignCurrency: Payments by hand are taken in ₹ only
ord_method_off_overLimit: Over the credit limit: needs the credit override and a reason
ord_method_off_creditOnHold: Credit is on hold for this business
ord_link_route_inr: ₹ → our INR gateway, which emails and texts the customer its own request (card, UPI or net banking)
ord_link_route_paypal: Other currencies → PayPal, which emails the customer its own request (PayPal sends no SMS)
ord_link_note_valid: The request goes to the billing contact once the order is placed; the price stays fixed until it expires.
ord_pieces_held_note: The pieces are held for this order from the moment it is saved, paid or not.
ord_cod_note: Payment shows “Due on delivery”. When the cash is collected, Record payment on the order with the receipt number as the reference.
ord_credit_override_reason: Reason to allow it once (super admin or “Credit override” permission)
ord_credit_override_help: Allowed once, with your name, the time and this reason kept.
ord_transfer_not_yet_checkout: Not yet: place the order as Awaiting payment
ord_coupon_refusal_usedUpForCustomer: this buyer has used it already
ord_coupon_refusal_belowMinimum: the order is below its minimum

ord_coupon_refusal_nothingEligible: no piece in the cart can take it
ord_checkout_foreign_note: {{inr}} in rupees, at the stored rate with the PayPal markup.
ord_warning_indiaBillingForeignCurrency: PayPal can’t take payments from India.
ord_warning_inrGatewayForeignCards: Until HDFC accepts cards issued abroad, the link’s pay page asks for the billing country’s currency.
ord_warning_smsNotIndianMobile: Our SMS goes only to Indian mobile numbers; this customer gets the request by email.
ord_invoice_needed_at_checkout: No complete Indian invoice address: the order will say “Invoice address needed” and can’t be packed until it is added.
ord_order_placed_request_sent: Order {{number}} placed and the payment request sent
ord_request_not_sent: The order is saved, but the payment request didn’t go. Send it from the order page.
addr_pin_found: We filled the city and State from the PIN code.
biz_list_note: The same records appear under Purchases › Suppliers when they sell to us. Each side keeps its own account; nothing is set off between them automatically.
biz_legal_name_help: As registered for GST. Printed on invoices and on purchase records.
biz_trade_name_help: What staff see in lists and pickers.
biz_gstin_ok: Format and check digit are right. State {{code}} is {{state}}.
biz_contacts_help: Payment links, statements and order messages go to the Accounts contact.
biz_buys_from_us_help: Shows it in Create order › Business, with its own customer account.
biz_credit_limit_help: The most it may owe us at once. 0 means every order is paid before it is placed.
biz_credit_needs_permission: Only staff with the credit permission can change this.
biz_credit_days_help: Sets the due date on each order placed on account.
biz_zone_help: The price level its orders use. RETAIL pays the shop’s price, sales included.
biz_zone_needs_permission: Only staff with the zone permission can change this.
biz_standing_help: Active · Credit on hold (orders only when paid) · Blocked (no new orders). Changing it asks for a reason.
biz_sells_to_us_help: Turn on to use it as a supplier: the supplier fields appear here.
biz_needs_a_role: A business must buy from us, sell to us, or both.
biz_standing_change_body: The standing becomes {{standing}}. Say why; the reason is kept with your name and the time.
biz_supplier_statement_note: The supplier statement already on Purchases › Suppliers, shown here unchanged.
biz_never_set_off_here: Shown side by side for information. The two accounts are only ever set off by a set-off entry under a written agreement.
biz_standing_active_help: Orders on account up to the credit limit.
biz_standing_creditOnHold_help: New orders only when paid by link, UPI, bank transfer or cash. Orders already placed carry on.
biz_standing_blocked_help: No new orders at all, paid or not. Existing orders carry on.
biz_receipt_oldest_first: It settles the oldest open orders on account first. A receipt number is given when it is saved.
zone_list_help: A zone is a business's price level. RETAIL pays the shop's price, sales included. Other zones price pieces by their rules, for orders staff place for businesses; the shop's prices never change.
zone_delete_body: No business uses it. Orders it already priced keep their prices.
zone_retail_note: RETAIL is the shop's own price, sales included. It has no rules and can't be changed or deleted.
zone_code_help: Capitals, digits and hyphens, e.g. WHOLESALE-A. Fixed once saved.
zone_tier_product_help: Tried first. The first rule that matches a piece prices it; drag to set the order.
zone_tier_category_help: Tried when no product exception matched. The first matching rule wins.
zone_tier_allProducts_help: Tried last, for every product. A piece no rule prices shows “Price not set for this zone”.
zone_problem_impossible_condition: A condition can never be true.
zone_problem_breaks_out_of_order: The steps must go up in order.
zone_problem_ends_before_start: The rule ends before it starts.
zone_status_saved_draft: The zone is a draft again
zone_words_intro: Tried in this order; the first rule that matches a piece prices it. Prices include GST.
zone_words_otherwise: Otherwise: Price not set for this zone.
zone_try_help: Prices real products with the rules as they are now, saved or not.
zone_remove_try: Take it out of Try it
zone_words_flat_with_skus: {{amount}}, with {{count}} SKU(s) priced on their own
zone_words_above_cost: {{percent}}% above the purchase cost (no cost: no price)
zone_addons_switch: Also apply to stitching and add-ons
zone_addons_not_this_formula: A flat price, a price per variant, a price per metre or % above cost prices the piece only; stitching and add-ons keep their listed price.
zone_words_addons_same: stitching and add-ons get the same reduction
zone_words_addons_listed: stitching and add-ons keep their listed price
zone_try_addons_percent: Stitching and add-ons: {{amount}}% off their listed price
zone_try_addons_amount: Stitching and add-ons: ₹{{amount}} off their listed price
zone_try_addons_listed: Stitching and add-ons: their listed price
cpn_bulk_refused: Not changed: {{codes}}. A coupon used on orders is switched off, never deleted.
cpn_code_help: Letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 24. Shoppers type it at checkout.
cpn_title_help: Staff only: what the coupon is for.
cpn_free_delivery_note: Free delivery is its own kind of coupon: it changes only the delivery charge.
cpn_applies_note: Each eligible piece and its stitching or other add-ons; never the delivery charge.
cpn_channel_shop: Shop checkout (the shopper types the code)
cpn_combines_help: Each coupon works on what is left after the one before; a piece never goes below ₹0.
cpn_zone_help: Off by default: a business priced by its zone doesn't get this coupon unless this is on.
cpn_reason_onSale: On sale: sale pieces are left out
cpn_reason_notInScope: Not in what the coupon covers
