cpn_reason_setLeftOut: A set: this coupon leaves sets out
cpn_words_free_delivery: Free delivery: only the delivery charge changes
cpn_words_percent: {{value}}% off each eligible piece and its stitching
cpn_words_amount: {{amount}} off, shared across the eligible pieces
cpn_words_categories_subs: Eligible: anything in {{list}} and their sub-categories
cpn_words_combines: Combines with other coupons that also combine
cpn_words_alone: Used on its own: it doesn't combine
ord_no_coupons_to_use: No coupon is switched on for admin orders.
ord_see_coupons: See the coupons this order can use
cust_use_as_default_delivery: Use as the default delivery address
cust_address_not_saved: The address could not be saved
addr_mobile_help_in: 10 digits. The code follows the country; you can change it for the phone only.
addr_mobile_help_intl: International format. The code follows the country; you can change it for the phone only.
addr_states_help_in: Only India’s {{count}} States and Union Territories are listed; filled from the PIN code.
ord_standing_hold_help: Orders can still be placed and paid by link, UPI, bank transfer or cash.
ord_standing_blocked_help: No new orders at all, paid or not. Existing orders carry on.
ord_new_address_typed_below: Typed below; saved to {{name}}’s addresses only if ticked.
ord_billing_separately_help: Unticked: billing is picked separately, from {{name}}’s saved addresses or typed new.
ord_ship_sent_abroad: Sent abroad: first piece, then {{count}} more
ord_coupon_refused_combine: {{code}} can’t be added: it doesn’t combine with other coupons. Remove {{others}} to use it instead.
ord_valid_until_inr: {{until}} ({{days}} days); the price stays fixed until then
ord_upi_ref_help: 12 digits, from the customer’s payment screen
ord_utr_placeholder: From the customer or the bank statement
ord_transfer_later_help: Add the UTR and mark it paid from the order when the money arrives.
ord_collector_courier_later: Or: the courier’s cash-on-delivery service, once a courier with that service is used.
ord_over_limit_help: Only {{available}} is available. Take part of it now by another method, ask for a payment against older invoices, or allow it once.
ord_credit_override_placeholder: For example: cheque for ₹1,00,000 received today, clearing on 22 Nov
ord_statement_line: The order is added to {{name}}’s customer account
ord_told_nothing_for: The customer is told nothing for {{status}}; their account shows it.
ord_told_shipped: The customer is told by email and SMS (Order shipped): courier, tracking number and the link if given. Channels follow Settings › Communications.
ord_told_delivered: The customer is told by email and SMS (Order delivered). Once a courier is connected, its delivery update and proof of delivery mark this by themselves.
ord_told_add_invoice_first: Add the invoice address from the yellow notice; Packed opens as soon as it is complete.
ord_hint_cancel_until_packed: Ready pieces can be cancelled until Packed
ord_cancel_refund_gateway: {{amount}} back through the INR gateway to the card or UPI used
ord_cancel_refund_manual: {{amount}} back the way it was paid
ord_cancel_stock_one: The piece goes back on sale
ord_cancel_told_refund: Order cancelled now; Refund processed when the gateway confirms
cpn_left_out_help: Products never discounted by this coupon.
cpn_sale_help: Off: sale pieces are left out (the rule you chose). On: this coupon also takes money off sale prices.
cpn_sets_help: On: a set takes the coupon like any product, shared over its pieces. Off: every set is left out, whatever category it sits in.
cpn_min_help: Counted on eligible pieces, before delivery.
cpn_per_customer_help: Once per customer, as you chose; change it here per coupon.
cpn_combines_switch_help: On: a shopper can use this together with other coupons that are also set to combine. Off: it is the only coupon on the order (one coupon per order).
cpn_order_of_use_value: Percentage coupons first, then ₹ off, then free delivery
cpn_automatic_offers_text: Sale prices from Events never stack with each other: the lowest price wins. Coupons then follow the rules above.
cpn_words_can_with: Can be used with {{codes}} and other coupons that combine.
cpn_words_cant_with: Can’t be used with {{codes}} (set to not combine).
biz_standing_recorded_note: Recorded with your name and the time; shown on the account and on Create order.
biz_type_help: Proprietorship, partnership, LLP, private or public limited company, HUF, trust or society, government, other.
biz_where_help: Shown side by side for information. The two accounts are only ever set off by a set-off entry under a written agreement; Saha Textile keeps this off.
ord_pay_lead_exact: Pays the amount due now in full.
ord_pay_rest_exact_open: Nothing will be due until more pieces are added or the order is closed with its shipping.

search_hint_businesses: Businesses that buy from us or sell to us: credit, standing, zone and both accounts.
search_hint_zones: Business price zones and their price rules.

ord_why_openTooLong: Open longer than the reminder in Settings › Orders.
ord_why_paymentReview: A gateway answer didn’t add up; check it on the order.

ord_why_requestExpiredUnpaid_on: on {{date}} without a payment. Send a new link or cancel.
ord_why_pendingAtBank_at: The bank said “pending” at {{time}}; no answer since.
ord_why_paymentReview_at: A gateway answer at {{time}} didn’t add up; check it on the order.
ord_why_openTooLong_since: Open since {{date}}, longer than the reminder in Settings › Orders.
ord_search_sms_form: (the number as it appears in an SMS, without hyphens)
ord_priced_by_on: Priced by “{{name}}”, version {{version}}, on {{date}} at {{time}}. Kept on the order; later versions never change it.
ord_req_sent_ccavenue: emailed and texted it to the customer in its own format, {{at}}.
ord_req_sent_razorpay: emailed and texted it to the customer in its own format, {{at}}.
ord_req_sent_paypal: emailed it to the customer (PayPal sends no SMS) in its own format, {{at}}.
ord_our_link_help: Opens our page, which forwards to the gateway’s request for the amount due.
ord_req_valid_held_one: {{date}} (the request); the piece stays held for this order
ord_req_valid_held_other: {{date}} (the request); the {{count}} pieces stay held for this order

payroll_posting_paid: Paid: Salary payable Dr · the bank Cr, for the net pay.

payroll_problem_employee_not_found: This employee isn't there any more.

payroll_problem_payroll_bank_needed: Pick the bank it was paid from and the day.
payroll_problem_books_not_set_up: Set up the books first (Settings › Company).

search_hint_payroll_advances: Advances given to staff, paid from cash or bank, and how much each payroll recovers.
search_hint_payroll_statutory: PF ECR, ESI, professional tax, labour welfare fund and TDS on salary: due dates, portal files and filed marks.
search_hint_setting_payroll_rules: Dated versions of PF, ESI, professional tax, labour welfare fund, bonus and gratuity rules; old months keep their version.

payroll_schemes_sub: Worked out every month from headcount and pay; you confirm when one starts.
payroll_scheme_next_pf_applies: Stays on even if headcount falls
payroll_scheme_next_pf_voluntary: Stays on even if headcount falls
payroll_scheme_next_pf_not_yet: Turn PF on for someone to join voluntarily
payroll_scheme_next_esi_not_yet: Register when you reach the headcount
payroll_scheme_next_bonus_applies: Pay the year's bonus within 8 months of year end
payroll_scheme_next_bonus_soon: Close to the headcount: plan for bonus
payroll_deduct_pf: Provident fund (12% of wages {{wages}}, the 50% rule)
payroll_rules_used: Rules used: pay rules from {{from}} · schemes from {{schemes}}. A reprint always shows these.
payroll_statutory_sub: files to upload to each portal
payroll_statutory_none: Nothing here yet. Returns appear once a month's payroll is posted.
payroll_filed_reference: Reference from the portal (TRRN, challan or acknowledgement number)
payroll_advance_note: Deductions stay within the Code on Wages limits; a loan can carry interest (perquisite rules for TDS). Leaving early: the balance goes to the full and final settlement.
payroll_advance_posting: Posts a payment: Staff advance Dr, the cash or bank ledger Cr. Each payroll then recovers the monthly amount.
payroll_rules_sub: Each rule is a dated version. A month uses the version in force that month, so old payslips never change.
payroll_rules_note: Values are presets to confirm with the CA. A law change is added as a new version dated from when it applies; earlier months keep the old one.
payroll_rule_wages_values: Basic + DA at least 50% of pay; allowances above that count as wages
payroll_rule_pf_values: {{rate}}% + {{rate}}% ({{eps}}% to pension) on wages up to ₹{{cap}}; admin charges {{admin}}% (at least ₹{{adminMin}}) and EDLI {{edli}}%; paid by day {{day}} of the next month
payroll_rule_esi_values: {{ee}}% + {{er}}% on pay up to ₹{{limit}}; paid by day {{day}} of the next month
payroll_rule_pt_values: {{taxes}} a month by salary slab; paid by day {{day}} of the next month
payroll_rule_lwf_values: ₹{{ee}} from the employee and ₹{{er}} from the employer in months {{months}}; paid by day {{day}} of the next month
payroll_rule_pt_period_values: {{taxes}} for each period by salary slab, deducted in months {{months}}; paid by day {{day}} of the next month
payroll_states_title: Professional tax and labour welfare fund, by State
payroll_states_none: Add at least one State; a run with someone whose State has no rules can't be approved.
payroll_pt_freq_none: Not at all (no professional tax in this State)
payroll_pt_slabs_half_yearly: Slabs on six months' salary (this month's times six), deducted in the months above.
payroll_pt_slabs_yearly: Slabs on a year's salary (this month's times twelve), deducted in the month above.
payroll_pt_slabs_none: Nothing is deducted for staff working in this State.
payroll_problem_payroll_state_rules_miss: Someone on this run works in a State the payroll rules don't cover yet. Add that State in Settings › Payroll rules, then prepare the run again.
payroll_state_missing: State rules missing: {{states}}. The run can't be approved until they are added in Settings › Payroll rules.
payroll_rule_deductions_values: Deductions, advances included, at most {{pct}}% of a month's wages
payroll_rule_bonus_values: {{rate}}% of basic and DA up to ₹{{ceiling}} a month (or the minimum wage, if higher)
payroll_rule_bonus_applies: {{n}}+ employees; basic and DA up to ₹{{limit}} a month (a warning from {{warn}})
payroll_bonus_f_ceiling: Bonus wages at most a month (₹)
payroll_bonus_f_limit: Covers basic and DA up to a month (₹)
payroll_bonus_provision_year_end: Only when the year's bonus is paid
payroll_bonus_short: {{name}}: provided {{provided}}, due {{due}}; the difference is booked when it is paid.
payroll_problem_bonus_paid: This year's bonus is already paid.
payroll_problem_bonus_nothing: No one is covered by the bonus this year.
payroll_rule_gratuity_values: {{days}}/{{monthDays}} × last wages × years; cap ₹20 lakh; provided for every month
payroll_rule_tds_values: New regime: standard deduction ₹{{std}}, no tax up to ₹{{rebate}} taxable; old regime: standard deduction ₹{{oldStd}}; cess {{cess}}%
payroll_decl_metro: Lives in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata or Chennai
payroll_decl_s80c: Section 80C: LIC, ELSS, PPF and the like (own PF counts by itself)
payroll_decl_previous_salary: Salary this year from an earlier employer, or before these books (₹)
payroll_tax_compare_title: This year, worked both ways (as saved) · {{age}}
payroll_tax_row_salaryPaise: Salary for the year (paid so far and expected)
payroll_tax_note: The run deducts by the {{regime}} chosen for the year; this comparison never switches it. Declarations count until the proof month, then only those with proof.
payroll_tax_note_proof: The run deducts by the {{regime}} chosen for the year; this comparison never switches it. It is the proof month: only declarations with proof count now.
payroll_tax_f_new_rebate: New regime: no tax up to (₹ taxable)
payroll_tax_f_old_rebate_up_to: Old regime rebate when taxable is up to (₹)
payroll_tax_rules_note: From the Finance Act and the Income-tax Act 2025, to be confirmed by the CA. A later Budget is a new version from its day; months already approved keep theirs.
payroll_rule_min_wages_values: Per skill and zone (check the latest notification)
payroll_f_gratuity_month: Days in a month for gratuity
payroll_problem_payroll_rules_before_app: A month on or after that day is already approved. Start the version after it.
payroll_problem_payroll_rules_from_taken: A version already starts that day.
payroll_problem_salary_template_not_foun: This structure isn't there any more.
payroll_problem_salary_template_changed: Someone else changed this structure. Reload the page.
payroll_problem_payslip_not_found: There's no payslip for this person this month.
payroll_problem_statutory_return_not_fou: This return isn't due from any posted payroll.
payroll_problem_statutory_already_filed: This return is already marked filed.
payroll_problem_employee_has_left: This person has left; settle the balance in the full and final settlement.
payroll_problem_structure_rest_twice: Only one head can take the rest.
payroll_problem_structure_over_100: The percentages add up to more than 100%.
payroll_problem_pt_last_slab_open: The last professional tax slab must cover every salary above it.
year_close_sub: The accountant prepares; the owner or the CA closes
year_close_check_cash: Every cash sheet closed, every difference settled
year_close_check_suspense: Suspense and clearing ledgers at zero
year_close_counts_open: {{n}} counts still open, or warehouse locations not counted yet.
year_close_suspense_hint: Settle or carry with a note.
year_close_carry_note: Why it carries into next year
year_close_closing_stale: The year changed after its closing entries; post them again.
year_close_profit_to: {{amount}} to the Profit and loss account
year_close_does_voucher_body: Income and expense ledgers to zero; the year's profit to the Profit and loss account, under Reserves and surplus for a company and Capital otherwise.
year_close_does_next_body: Opens with every balance sheet ledger, party bill and stock layer carried; reports still read the closed year as it was.
year_close_choice_unsaved: Save the choice to see what it posts.
year_close_choice_keep: Keep it in the profit and loss account
year_close_choice_keep_help: Shown under capital (reserves for a company) in the balance sheet; nothing is posted.
year_close_choice_to_capital: Move it to the proprietor's capital
year_close_choice_to_capital_help: Profit and loss to capital, and drawings closed into capital.
year_close_choice_to_capital_keep_drawin: Move it to capital, keep drawings apart
Profit and loss to capital; drawings stay in their own account.
year_close_choice_deed: Share it as the deed says
year_close_choice_deed_help: Interest on capital and remuneration first, then the rest in the ratio, each to the partner's current account.
year_close_choice_ratio_only: Share it in the ratio only
year_close_choice_ratio_only_help: The whole profit or loss in the profit-sharing ratio, with no interest or remuneration.
year_close_choice_to_general_reserve: Keep it as surplus, with part to general reserve
year_close_choice_to_general_reserve_hel: Dividends are declared later by the board or the members and posted then, never at close.
year_close_reserve_basis: How much goes to general reserve
year_close_share_tdsPaise: TDS on interest and remuneration (10%, over ₹20,000 a year)
year_close_share_limit: Tax limit on remuneration: {{limit}}, on book profit after interest of {{profit}}; {{over}} would not be allowed for tax. The deed still decides what is paid.
year_close_share_interest_over: {{amount}} of the interest is above 12% a year and not allowed for tax.
year_close_share_loss_year: A loss year: the deed pays no interest or remuneration in a loss, so the loss is shared in the ratio.
year_close_capital_after: Drawings closed into capital: {{drawings}} · capital after: {{capital}}

year_close_plan_problem_partner_shares_t: The partners' shares in a deed don't add up to 100%.
year_close_plan_problem_partners_missing: The deed has no partners. Add them in Settings › Company.
year_close_plan_problem_no_location: Add a location first: the owners' accounts are kept at the head office.
year_close_problem_profit_choice_not_off: That choice isn't offered for this kind of business.
year_close_problem_profit_plan_partner_l: A partner has no capital ledger yet. Add it from Settings › Company, then try again.
year_close_problem_profit_plan_partner_s: The partners' shares in a deed don't add up to 100%.
year_close_problem_profit_plan_partners_: The deed has no partners. Add them in Settings › Company.
year_close_problem_profit_plan_no_locati: Add a location first: the owners' accounts are kept at the head office.
year_close_problem_profit_plan_ledger_mi: A ledger this posting needs is missing. Set up the books again from Settings › Company.
year_close_problem_failed: That didn't go through. Try again.
year_close_problem_year_close_checks_ope: Some checks are still open. Finish them first.
year_close_problem_year_close_nothing: Nothing to close: no income or expense this year.
year_close_problem_books_not_set_up: Set up the books first (Settings › Company).
year_close_problem_reverse_super_admin_o: Only the super admin can post the closing entries again.

import_start_year_start: At a year start, with opening balances as at 31 March
import_start_date: On a date you choose, with balances as at the day before
import_start_history: With the full history of past vouchers (not available yet)
import_check_placed: Every ledger with a balance has a place
import_check_not_brought: Stock, open bills and fixed assets are not read from the file

import_does_opening_body: One opening journal dated the day before the books start, in one transaction; new ledgers are made first.
import_does_undo_body: The whole import can be undone until the first new entry is posted.
import_done_line: Brought in: {{amount}} each side, {{made}} new ledgers made.
import_problem_failed: That didn't go through. Try again.
import_problem_import_nothing_read: No ledgers could be read from this file. Check the program and the columns.
import_problem_import_ledgers_to_choose: Choose where the remaining ledgers go.
import_problem_import_not_balanced: The opening balances don't balance: debits and credits differ.
import_problem_import_nothing_to_bring: Every balance in the file is zero.
import_problem_location_unknown: Pick the location the balances sit at.
import_problem_import_group_unknown: That group isn't in the chart of accounts.
import_problem_import_not_found: This import isn't there any more.
import_problem_import_books_in_use: New entries have been posted since; undo them first or correct with a journal.
import_problem_reverse_super_admin_only: Only the super admin can undo an import.

export_format_trial_balance_csv: Trial balance (CSV, our import template's columns)

caro_reportable: {{n}} class difference reaches 10%: the auditor reports it, with how it was dealt with in the books.
caro_none_reportable: No class difference reaches 10% in this period.
caro_no_counts: No stock count posted in this period.

gstr1_table_cmp_rcm: Reverse-charge tax on what came in

gstr1_check_pmt06_no_last_quarter: No GSTR-3B with cash for the last quarter: use the month's own tax
gstr1_check_pmt06_month_not_worked: The month's tax couldn't be worked out
gstr1_check_cmp08_turnover_below_zero: Credit notes are more than the quarter's bills ({{document}})
gstr1_check_isd_no_recipients: No other GSTIN to share the credit with
gstr1_check_isd_no_turnover: No other GSTIN had sales in the period the ratio is taken from
gstr1_check_isd_credit_below_zero: Credit notes are more than the month's invoices
gst_problem_return_quarter_end_only: This return is for a quarter: open it from the quarter's last month.
gst_problem_return_not_for_this_gstin: This GSTIN doesn't file that return for that month.
gst_problem_gstr6a_needed: Choose the month's GSTR-6A file first.
gst_problem_gstr6a_other_gstin: That GSTR-6A is for another GSTIN.
gst_problem_gstr6a_other_month: That GSTR-6A is for another month.
gst_problem_gstr6a_file_unreadable: That file isn't a GSTR-6A from the portal.
gst_problem_gstr6a_line_unreadable: A line in that GSTR-6A can't be read.
gst_problem_distribution_not_isd: Only an approved GSTR-6 with shares can be distributed.
gst_pay_help: Pays {{amount}} from a bank account with the challan's CPIN or CIN.
gst_post_payment_body_PMT-06: Puts the deposit in the GST cash ledger; the quarter's GSTR-3B uses it first.
gst_post_payment_body_CMP-08: Books the quarter's composition tax as an expense and pays it, with any reverse-charge tax.
gst_post_distribution_body: Moves each GSTIN's share of the credit from the ISD to it; their GSTR-3B takes it in 4A(4).
eb_list_subtitle: Bills for services and expenses (rent, software, the CA's fees) with their GST credit.
eb_list_empty: No expense bills in this period.
eb_form_line: Posted, the expense and its input credit go into the books at the billed location, and the supplier is owed the bill.
eb_use_self_invoice: This supplier has no GSTIN, so they can't charge GST. If the tax is yours to pay under reverse charge, record it as a self-invoice instead.
eb_composition_help: This GSTIN is under composition, so it takes no input credit: the tax joins each expense.
eb_posting_help: Post: each expense is debited (blocked tax joins it), claimable input tax is debited at the billed location, and the supplier is credited the total. It is paid later with a payment voucher, as purchase bills are.
eb_cancel_body_posted: {{number}} is in the books. Cancelling posts the opposite entry today; the number stays used.
eb_cancel_body_draft: {{number}} is a draft, so nothing is in the books yet.
eb_problem_expense_bill_not_found: This expense bill doesn't exist any more.
eb_problem_expense_bill_not_draft: Only a draft can be changed or posted.
eb_problem_expense_bill_changed: Someone else saved this bill first. Reload to see their change.
eb_problem_expense_bill_not_an_expense: Each line needs an expense ledger.
eb_problem_expense_bill_no_gstin: This location bills under no GSTIN, so no input credit can be claimed here. Mark the lines Blocked or pick another location.
eb_problem_expense_bill_composition_no_c: This GSTIN is under composition and takes no input credit. Mark the lines Blocked.
eb_problem_use_self_invoice: A supplier without a GSTIN can't charge GST. Under reverse charge, record a self-invoice instead.
eb_problem_supplier_unknown: That supplier isn't on the list any more.
eb_problem_location_unknown: That location isn't on the list any more.
search_hint_expense_bills: Suppliers' bills for services and expenses (rent, software, fees), with their GST credit.
eb_pay_voucher_note: A payment voucher (PV) is issued with this payment and both go into the books together.
eb_problem_expense_bill_paid: Something is paid on this bill. Cancel its payment vouchers first.
eb_problem_expense_bill_not_posted: Only a posted bill can be paid.
eb_problem_expense_bill_paid_before_bill: A payment can't be dated before the bill.
eb_problem_overpayment: That's more than is left to pay on this bill.
eb_problem_paid_in_future: A payment can't be dated after today.
eb_problem_payment_needs_a_bank_ledger: The books have no bank account to pay from yet. Add one in Accounts › Ledgers.
eb_problem_payment_choose_bank_ledger: Choose which bank account it was paid from.
gstr1_check_isd_bill_not_in_books: An invoice in GSTR-6A isn't booked as an expense bill to the ISD yet. Book it in Purchases › Expense bills, billed to the ISD's location.
gstr1_check_isd_bill_tax_differs: An invoice's tax in GSTR-6A differs from its expense bill by more than ₹1.
accounts_delete_draft_body: The draft goes for good; nothing was posted from it.
